description: The null distribution of the SVM's shuffled-label control (classical_svm_1's control reached 0.319 validation UA and 0.321 test UA, above the 0.30 alarm): the eGeMAPS v02 SVM with per-speaker z-scores, rbf kernel and the same C and gamma lists, trained on shuffled training labels, with 20 new shuffles (seeds 2 to 21; seed 1 was classical_svm_1's control), with class-balanced weights as there and without class weights, to test whether balanced weights push a chance model toward the two smallest classes. Every configuration here is a control. Validation and test are both read: nothing here is ever selected.
